era_en: 1907-1971 : Late Qing to the People's Republic of China (born into a landlord family in Linjiawan, Hubei — entered the Whampoa Military Academy's fourth class at eighteen — joined the CCP and fought in the Northern Expedition and the Nanchang Uprising — commanded the Red 1st Army Corps at twenty-three during the Long March, seizing the Luding Bridge and breaking Lazikou — won the Battle of Pingxingguan in 1937, the first major Chinese victory of the War of Resistance — led the Northeast Field Army 1946-48 through the Liaoshen Campaign, then took North China and swept south to Hainan — Marshal of the PLA 1955 — named Mao's successor in the Party constitution 1969 — died in a plane crash at Öndörkhaan, Mongolia, September 1971)
school: 中国人民解放军战术学派 / 大兵团运动战 / 精算型指挥传统
historical_significance: 林彪（1907-1971），中华人民共和国元帅，中国人民解放军最具体系性的战术家之一。湖北黄冈林家大湾人，黄埔军校第四期出身，十八岁加入中国共产党，参加北伐战争与南昌起义、湘南起义，随朱德上井冈山。二十三岁任红一军团军团长，长征中率部担任前卫：强渡乌江、飞夺泸定桥、突破腊子口，其部队始终是开路前锋；1936年任红军大学（抗日红军大学）校长。抗日战争爆发后任八路军115师师长，1937年9月指挥平型关战斗，歼灭日军板垣师团一部千余人，取得全国抗战开始后中国军队的第一个重大胜利，林彪由此名扬全国，同年因友军误击负伤赴苏联疗养。解放战争时期赴东北主政军事，将出关的十余万部队发展为百万人的东北野战军：1946-47年三下江南、四保临江扭转东北战局；1948年9月至11月指挥辽沈战役，力排'先打长春'之议，定下先取锦州、'关门打狗'的方针，53天歼敌47万，解放东北全境；随后率百万大军入关指挥平津战役，以军事压力促成北平和平解放；1949年率第四野战军南下，经衡宝、广东、广西诸战役直至1950年海南岛登陆战，将红旗插遍中南。1955年授元帅军衔，位列第三。他总结的'一点两面、四快一慢、三三制、三猛、三种情况三种打法、四组一队'六大战术原则，把实战经验提炼成可教学、可复制、可在教导队中轮训的条令体系，是人民军队战术训练的奠基文献；其办军事教育的路数——先把复杂战场问题拆成可传授的口诀与检查项——本身就是一种知识工程。1959年后主持军委工作，'文化大革命'中成为党内名义上的接班人并写入党章，1971年9月13日因政变阴谋败露乘机外逃，坠机身亡于蒙古温都尔汗，史称'九一三事件'。其晚年政治生涯的彻底失败不能抹去其军事思想在战役战术层面的体系性价值——研究他的思维模式，正是研究一个把战争当作可精算工程的天才头脑如何在政治上失算的完整样本。
historical_significance_en: Lin Biao (1907-1971), Marshal of the People's Republic of China, was the most systematizing tactician of the People's Liberation Army. Born in Linjiawan, Huanggang, Hubei, a fourth-class Whampoa Military Academy graduate, he joined the CCP at eighteen and fought in the Northern Expedition, the Nanchang Uprising, and the Hunan Autumn Uprising before following Zhu De to Jinggangshan. At twenty-three he commanded the Red 1st Army Corps and led the vanguard throughout the Long March — crossing the Wu River, seizing the Luding Bridge, breaking Lazikou — and served as president of the Red Army University in 1936. In the War of Resistance he commanded the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army and directed the Battle of Pingxingguan in September 1937, annihilating over a thousand troops of the Itagaki Division — China's first major victory of the war — before being wounded by friendly fire and sent to the Soviet Union to recover. In the civil war he built the ~100,000 troops entering Manchuria into the million-man Northeast Field Army: the three drives south of the Songhua and four defenses of Linjiang (1946-47) turned the theater, and in the Liaoshen Campaign (Sept-Nov 1948) he overrode the 'take Changchun first' argument, struck Jinzhou first to 'shut the door and beat the dog,' and destroyed 470,000 enemy troops in fifty-three days. He then led the army through the Pingjin Campaign, securing the peaceful liberation of Beiping, and swept south with the Fourth Field Army through Hengbao, Guangdong, and Guangxi to the Hainan landing of 1950. Named Marshal in 1955 (ranking third), he distilled his battlefield experience into six tactical principles — one point two flanks, four fast one slow, the three-three system, the three fiercenesses, three situations three methods, four groups one team — a teachable, replicable doctrine that became the founding literature of PLA tactical training; his very approach to military education — decomposing complex battlefield problems into transmissible formulas and checklists — was itself a form of knowledge engineering. After 1959 he ran the Military Affairs Commission; during the Cultural Revolution he was named Mao's successor in the Party constitution, but on 13 September 1971, after an alleged coup plot collapsed, he died in a plane crash at Öndörkhaan, Mongolia (the '9.13 Incident'). The total failure of his late political career cannot erase the systematic value of his military thought at the operational and tactical level — and studying his thinking modes means studying the complete specimen of a mind that computed war as engineering and yet miscalculated politics.
unique_thinking: 林彪的独特处在于一种'工程师式的战争精算学'：第一，他把'打不打'从勇气问题还原为胜率问题——不打无准备之仗、不打无把握之仗，出手之前先把把握性算清，这是他全部战术体系的闸门；第二，他把战场判断从直觉升级为细账——敌情、地形、弹药、士气全部纳入可数变量，四快一慢中的'一慢'正是用慢换准备成熟，快与慢被拆开分别赋值；第三，他把兵力密度翻译成队形语言——一点两面解决'往哪里打'，三三制解决'怎么在打的过程中活下来'，突击的锐度与存活的韧度被同时设计；第四，他坚持复盘制度化——胜仗要算出侥幸的占比，败仗要找出客观约束的边界，经验必须沉淀为条令才能进入下一次战斗。这套思维的本质是：把战争从艺术还原为可教学、可复制、可迭代改进的工程。
unique_thinking_en: Lin Biao's distinctiveness lay in an engineer's calculus of war: first, he reduced 'whether to fight' from a question of courage to a question of odds — fight no battle unprepared, no battle without a sure grasp — computing readiness before the gate of every operation; second, he upgraded battlefield judgment from intuition to fine accounting — enemy, terrain, ammunition, morale all entering as countable variables, with the 'one slow' of four-fast-one-slow trading slowness for ripeness, fast and slow assigned their values separately; third, he translated troop density into the language of formation — one-point-two-flanks answers 'where to strike,' the three-three system answers 'how to survive while striking,' the sharpness of assault and the resilience of survival designed together; fourth, he institutionalized the after-action review — counting the luck inside every victory, bounding the constraints inside every defeat, and sedimenting experience into doctrine so it could enter the next battle. The essence: reducing war from art to an engineering discipline — teachable, replicable, iteratively improvable.
civilization_zh: 中国近现代——一个从黄埔四期走出的青年军官，二十三岁任红一军团军团长，长征路上率前卫连夺泸定桥、破腊子口；抗战首役平型关即打出全国瞩目的一仗；解放战争中执掌东北野战军，从三下江南到辽沈决战，以'一点两面、四快一慢、三三制'六大战术原则把百万部队锻造成解放战争的主攻手，随后率军入关直下平津、挥师江南，直至打下海南岛——他证明：战争是可以被精算的，胜负在开打之前就已经在细账里
civilization_en: Modern China — a young officer out of the fourth Whampoa class who commanded the Red 1st Army Corps at twenty-three, led the vanguard that seized the Luding Bridge and broke through Lazikou on the Long March, fought the nationally celebrated Battle of Pingxingguan in the first campaign of the War of Resistance, then as commander of the Northeast Field Army in the civil war forged a million-man force into the main assault arm of the revolution through his six tactical principles — one point two flanks, four fast one slow, the three-three system — before sweeping into North China and all the way to Hainan Island: proof that war can be calculated, and that victory is decided in the fine arithmetic before the fighting starts
roles_en: Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Committee (until 1971)
key_works: 辽沈战役作战方针电报

cross_references.description_zh: 林彪与孙武共享'慎战而后胜'的母题：孙武讲'主不可以怒而兴师''非利不动，非得不用，非危不战'，把开战的闸门设在利益与胜算之前；林彪把它落实为'不打无准备之仗、不打无把握之仗'的可执行检查流程。平行命题：最高的战斗精神恰恰体现在敢于不出手——慎战不是怯战，而是把胜利前提前置。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Biao and Sun Wu share the motif of 'caution before victory': Sun Wu taught that no sovereign should raise arms in anger — 'act not unless there is gain, use not unless there is certainty, fight not unless in peril' — placing the gate to war ahead of gain and odds; Lin Biao operationalized it as the executable checklist of 'fight no battle unprepared, no battle you are not sure of winning.' Parallel thesis: the highest martial spirit shows in daring not to strike — caution is not cowardice but moving the preconditions of victory to the front.

cross_references.description_zh: 林彪与朱可夫共享'节奏与准备'的母题却各有侧重：朱可夫的预备队决胜法在时间轴上保留后手，林彪的四快一慢法在总攻时点上刻意取慢——两人都拒绝把'快'当作普遍美德，都主张在最关键的投入上以慢制胜；平行命题：节奏本身是武器，最慢的那个动作往往定义整场战斗。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Biao and Zhukov share the motif of tempo and preparation with different emphases: Zhukov's decisive reserve holds the last move in reserve along the timeline, while Lin's four-fast-one-slow deliberately slows the single moment of general assault — both refuse speed as a universal virtue and both win at the crucial commitment through slowness. Parallel thesis: tempo itself is a weapon, and the slowest action often defines the battle.

cross_references.description_zh: 林彪与克劳塞维茨同以战争为认知对象而方法相反：克劳塞维茨强调'战争中的摩擦'使一切计划在接触后失效，把战争归于不可完全计算的政治延续与偶然性王国；林彪用细账主义反向逼近——侦察数据、弹药基数、伤亡预估全部纳入可数变量，四快一慢甚至把'慢'本身做成对冲摩擦的机制；对比命题：面对同一团战争迷雾，一个选择敬畏它的哲学，一个选择精算它的工程。
cross_references.description_en: Lin Biao and Clausewitz take war as an object of knowledge with opposite methods: Clausewitz stressed friction — every plan failing on contact — and consigned war to the realm of politics and chance that cannot be fully computed; Lin Biao's fine-accounting approached from the other side — reconnaissance data, ammunition bases, casualty estimates all entering as countable variables, with four-fast-one-slow even turning slowness itself into a hedge against friction. Contrast thesis: facing the same fog of war, one chose a philosophy of reverence for it, the other an engineering of computing it.

modes.name_en: The Method of Cautious War, Assured Victory
modes.domain_zh: 把'打不打'放在'怎么打'之前——用胜率的严格核算决定是否出手
modes.domain_en: Placing 'whether to fight' before 'how to fight' — committing only after a strict accounting of the odds
modes.source_chapter: 《战争和战略问题》前后对作战时机的一贯主张；平型关战前反复推敲敌情地形
modes.key_quote_zh: 不打无准备之仗，不打无把握之仗
modes.key_quote_en: "Fight no battle unprepared; fight no battle you are not sure of winning"

modes.name_en: The Method of Fine Calculation on the Battlefield
modes.domain_zh: 用可数的细节（敌情、地形、弹药、士气）代替不可靠的直觉做判断
modes.domain_en: Replacing unreliable intuition with countable detail — enemy dispositions, terrain, ammunition, morale
modes.source_chapter: 《论短促突击》《军事侦察工作》中的量化推敲传统
modes.key_quote_zh: 要算细账，不要算糊涂账
modes.key_quote_en: "Run the fine arithmetic, not the muddled account"

modes.name_en: The Method of One Point, Two Flanks
modes.domain_zh: 集中主力于一点形成绝对优势突破，同时以两面包抄截断敌人退路与援路
modes.domain_en: Concentrating the main force on a single breakthrough point in absolute superiority while enveloping on two flanks to sever retreat and reinforcement
modes.source_chapter: 《一点两面战术》（三下江南、四平作战总结）
modes.key_quote_zh: 集中兵力于一点上，两面以包抄之势断敌退路
modes.key_quote_en: "Concentrate the force on one point; envelop on two sides to cut the enemy's retreat"

modes.name_en: The Method of Four Fast, One Slow
modes.domain_zh: 向敌前进要快、抓住敌人要快、突破后扩张要快、追击要快——唯独总攻发起时间要慢，慢到准备真正成熟
modes.domain_en: Advance fast, fix the enemy fast, exploit fast, pursue fast — but delay the general assault until preparation is truly ripe
modes.source_chapter: 《四快一慢战术》（1948 年东北野战军战术讲话）
modes.key_quote_zh: 准备要慢——总攻发起时机要在一切准备好之后
modes.key_quote_en: "Be slow only in launching the assault — launch it only when everything is ready"

modes.name_en: The Method of the Three-Three Formation
modes.domain_zh: 以三人小组为基本单元、三组一班梯次展开，把兵力密度转译为生存力与连续突击力
modes.domain_en: Organizing the assault around three-man cells in echeloned squads, converting troop density into survivability and sustained shock
modes.source_chapter: 《三三制战术》（东北野战军六大战术原则之一）
modes.key_quote_zh: 疏散配置、小组突进，一两人伤亡不打乱整个队形
modes.key_quote_en: "Disperse and configure in small groups — one or two casualties must not break the formation"

modes.name_en: The Method of Short Sharp Annihilation
modes.domain_zh: 以最短的时间、最近的距离、最猛的火力完成突击，不给敌调整部署的间隙
modes.domain_en: Delivering the strike at the shortest range, in the shortest time, with the heaviest fire — never allowing the enemy time to redeploy
modes.source_chapter: 《论短促突击》（1934 年第五次反'围剿'期间）
modes.key_quote_zh: 突击要短促，接触即解决战斗
modes.key_quote_en: "The assault must be short and sharp — settle the fight on contact"

modes.name_en: The Method of Seizing the Moment
modes.domain_zh: 在战机窗口出现的一瞬间压上全部决心——迟疑本身是最大的战损
modes.domain_en: Committing the whole will the instant the window opens — hesitation itself is the heaviest casualty
modes.source_chapter: 辽沈战役中下决心先打锦州、关门打狗的决策过程
modes.key_quote_zh: 战机稍纵即逝，看准了就要断然处置
modes.key_quote_en: "Opportunities vanish in an instant — once seen, act decisively"

modes.name_en: The Method of Turning the Board
modes.domain_zh: 在整体劣势下寻找局部可以做成绝对优势的棋眼，以局部胜利撬动全局
modes.domain_en: Under overall disadvantage, finding the local point where absolute superiority can be built, and leveraging a local victory into the whole
modes.source_chapter: 东北战局从'先取长春'之争到'南下北宁线'的战略转向
modes.key_quote_zh: 把敌人必救之地变成我们的必胜之地
modes.key_quote_en: "Turn the ground the enemy must rescue into the ground where we cannot lose"

modes.name_en: The Method of Politics Commanding the Gun
modes.domain_zh: 把部队的士气与忠诚视为与火力同等重要的作战变量，用政治工作为战术体系供能
modes.domain_en: Treating morale and loyalty as operational variables coequal with firepower, and fueling the tactical system through political work
modes.source_chapter: 《关于部队政治工作问题》及其在四野的练兵实践
modes.key_quote_zh: 兵民是胜利之本，士气是火力之源
modes.key_quote_en: "The people and their army are the foundation of victory; morale is the source of firepower"

modes.domain_zh: 把每一次作战得失拆解复盘，胜仗也要找出侥幸成分，败仗也要找出客观约束
modes.domain_en: Dissecting every battle for what was luck and what was constraint — victory included, defeat included
modes.source_chapter: 历次战役总结讲话中反复进行的复盘检讨传统
modes.key_quote_zh: 打了胜仗也要算一算赢得多少是碰上的
modes.key_quote_en: "Even in victory, count how much was luck"
